thread:
acme-oncall: Hey team — our users started getting SSO failures after IdP cert rotation ~1h ago. Multiple tenants. 403 on redirect.
maria: Sorry — can you paste the SP/IdP metadata you see and one of the error responses?
acme-oncall: Paste logs:
```
SAMLResponse: ValidSignature=FALSE
Assertion AudienceMismatch: expected 'https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs' got 'https://app.prod.redwood.com/sso/acs'
RecipientCheckFailed
``` 
acme-oncall: We have an idp-metadata URL that previously had hostnames [app.redwood.com, app.prod.redwood.com] — IdP rotated and published a new cert bundle and split hostnames into separate <AssertionConsumerService> entries.
jordan: That audience mismatch usually means ACS host alias in metadata doesn't match SP entity or our ACS normalization. Did you update the SP entityID or the tenant-config to include the hostpair?
acme-oncall: We didn't change tenant config. The IdP did a dual-host publish.
ingrid: Understood — looks like our metadata poller may have cached the old descriptor and the CDN in front of IdP returned a stale variant for some regions. Can you run `curl -v` against the IdP metadata endpoint and paste the ETag/Date? Also please include `X-Forwarded-Host` if any.
acme-oncall: curl output:
```
$ curl -I https://idp.acme.example.com/metadata
HTTP/2 200
date: Tue, 12 Nov 2024 16:02:10 GMT
etag: "v2-20241112"
cache-control: max-age=600
content-type: application/samlmetadata+xml
```
maria: Ok — two parallel issues: (1) IdP published metadata with multiple ACS entries (hostpair) and switched cert bundle; (2) our metadata watcher polled in between and picked up mixed state -> some of our nodes have the old ACS mapping but new cert fingerprint => signature validation fails.
jordan: Repro steps (staging):
1. set tenant `acme-corp` idp_url -> https://idp.acme.example.com/metadata
2. simulate rotation by serving metadata variant A then B with different `<KeyDescriptor>` ordering
3. run `./bin/metadata-watcher --poll-interval 30 --debug`
4. send SAML AuthnRequest and inspect `Assertion AudienceMismatch` or `ValidSignature=false`

jordan: Quick triage commands:
```
curl -sS https://idp.acme.example.com/metadata | xmllint --format - | sed -n '1,160p'
curl -sS https://idp.acme.example.com/metadata -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' > /tmp/idp.xml
openssl x509 -in /tmp/idp-cert.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha256
``` 
maria: Temporary mitigations: (A) purge our metadata cache and force watcher restart on nodes serving acme tenants; (B) ask IdP to re-publish a single normalized metadata entry or include both ACS as `isDefault` semantics; (C) enable `allow-acs-alias` tenant flag (opt-in) while we reconcile.
acme-oncall: We'll coordinate with IdP. Can you purge cache? Which nodes to restart?
ingrid: I'm spinning a quick redeploy to metadata-watcher pool in us-east-1 and purging s3 cached object key `idp-acme-corp-metadata.json`. Running now.
deploy-bot: metadata-watcher (us-east-1) deploy started by ingrid — build 2024.11.12-764
deploy-bot: purge s3://redwood-metadata-cache/idp-acme-corp-metadata.json — OK
jordan: After purge, please hit our SP with the failing tenant and paste new assertion logs. Also check our tenant config `expected_acs` list; if they only have `https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs` we need to add the alias.
acme-oncall: Post-purge logs:
```
ValidSignature=TRUE
Assertion AudienceOK
200 OK redirect
```
acme-oncall: Looks fixed for ~90% of users. A small percent still hitting edge nodes in eu-west-1 showing old behavior.
ingrid: I'll restart watcher in eu-west-1 and invalidate CloudFront edge cache for `/.well-known/saml/idp/<tenant>` — ping when done.
maria: Action items:
- ingrid: restart watcher in eu-west-1 + invalidate CF (ETA 10m)
- acme-oncall: confirm with IdP they will consolidate metadata or add ACS aliases to SP config (ETA 1h)
- jordan: add a guard in metadata-watcher to validate consistency (atomic apply) and emit anomaly alert when KeyDescriptor ordering changes (ETA PR end of week)
- support: follow up with customer once eu nodes stable

acme-oncall: Thanks all — will update here after IdP confirms. :thumbsup:
maria: Marking this P1-> support escalation resolved for now; re-open if you see further 403s.
